name: Ordswap
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: On October 10th, the BRC20 exchange platform Ordswap issued a tweet, stating that they had lost control of their website domain, and the issue appeared to be related to the website development and hosting company Netlify. They advised users not to access their website until they regained control of the domain. Ordswap users reported that the compromised website was redirecting users to phishing links.
